what: T1XFER: warm-start a WEAK Tier 1 clip from a STRONG clip's actor
registered_at: 2026-10-30 06:10 UTC, before the pilot box is repurposed
the_idea: Every weak-clip arm so far has warm-started a clip from ITS OWN actor, which has converged on failing that clip -- 0 of 4 below 0.35 ever adopted. A strong clip's actor has learned to manipulate. All 30 shipped actors share one tensor-shape signature and one policy_schema_json, so a donor actor loads for any clip: checked locally from the safetensors headers, 30 of 30 identical.
why_it_displaces_the_pilot: A warm start is 50M steps (~30 min, ~$0.50) against 350M from scratch (~3.5 h, ~$3.00). The remaining $2.61 buys ONE from-scratch clip or FOUR cross-clip clips. Four clips of a $7 arm is both better evidence and a more actionable answer than one clip of a $34 arm, so the cheaper hypothesis is tested first. The from-scratch pilot had run 19 minutes, about $0.21, and its real value is already banked: it found the stage-path bug that would have killed a five-box T1WEAK launch.
donor: e08's FINE-TUNED actor, kit AUC 0.9236 at 1.43 cm MPPE -- our best, and trained on a clean Tier 1 reference, which is what the targets also use. Path ws_s4a/results/rollouts/e08_policy.safetensors.
recipe: run_warm_start.sh, which reads the stage per clip from its plan and so respects each parquet's recorded absolute object path -- the thing that broke the flattened pilot. start_curriculum + orientation std 0.3 + object_position std 0.08, seed 42, warm start at 299,999,232 to 349,999,104 steps, actor LR x0.1 for the first 2,000 updates, critic cold.
the_bar: Per clip, beat its shipped Tier 1 AUC with no other board regressing -- the standing Tier 1 rule. The ARM works if at least one of the four adopts. If none does, both weak-clip routes have failed and the honest conclusion is that weak clips need a method change rather than more training, which withdraws the $40 ask entirely.
what_this_would_mean_if_it_works: 11 weak clips at ~$0.50 is about $7 rather than $34, so the ask drops from $40 to $10 and the whole Tier 1 rebuild becomes affordable within one top-up.
donor_load_verified: e19's train log reports: 'warm start: actor from /v2d/assets/ckpt/donor/policy.safetensors, steps set to 299,999,232, curriculum stage voc_scale=0.0'. So the donor actor is genuinely the starting point -- a run that had silently trained from scratch would score like a different arm and the comparison would be worthless.

if_the_pilot_adopts_the_full_arm_is_chea.candidates: All 19 Tier 1 clips the no-regression rule has NOT adopted -- not just the 11 weak ones. Twelve of the 19 were tried with their OWN actor and rejected, and that is the thing this arm changes; seven were never tried at all.
if_the_pilot_adopts_the_full_arm_is_chea.cost: 19 clips x 0.5 h = 9.5 box-hours = $6.46, three boxes at 3.2 h each, about $7.30 with bring-ups. Against $32.91 for the eleven weak clips from scratch.
if_the_pilot_adopts_the_full_arm_is_chea.no_stage_grouping_needed: run_warm_start.sh reads the stage per clip from its plan, so one box can mix clips from any stage. That removes the five-box stage grouping T1WEAK needed and the absolute-object-path trap that broke the flattened pilot.
if_the_pilot_adopts_the_full_arm_is_chea.the_ask_becomes: $10 rather than $40, and it covers every unadopted Tier 1 clip rather than eleven of them.

why_the_rejected_twelve_matter_most: Their own-actor fine-tunes did not merely fail to improve -- all twelve came back WORSE on MPPE, several catastrophically (e02 4.57 -> 35.05 cm, e21 4.79 -> 10.34). That is the signature of an actor refitting toward a reference it cannot track. A donor that already tracks its own clip to 1.43 cm starts from competence instead.
